messages.subject: conditionalPanel unused arguments
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm having some trouble doing nested drop down menus using conditionalPanel().  I'm a bit confused, because I call input.xChoice, unless it wants a conditionalPanel for each of the input choices.  Thanks for your insight.

ui.R
# X Axis
    wellPanel(
      strong('X-Axis Variable'),
      selectInput(inputID='xChoice',label="Choose an area:",
                  choices=c('Personality Traits','Cognitive Ability',
                            'Vocational Interests')),
      conditionalPanel(condition="input.xChoice == 'Personality Traits'",
                       selectInput(inputId="x.var",
                                   choices = c('Openness','Conscientiousness',
                                               'Extraversion','Agreeableness',
                                               'Neuroticism'),
                                   multiple=FALSE),
      ),
      uiOutput("x_range_slider")),

Error in selectInput(inputID = "xChoice", label = "Choose an area:", choices = c("Personality Traits", : unused argument(s) (inputID = "xChoice") Calls: runApp ... wellPanel -> div -> <Anonymous> -> tag -> selectInput

messages.subject: Re: conditionalPanel unused arguments
parts:
Hi Jason -

I think the problem is just that in your selectInput, "inputID" should be "inputId".

-Winston
